from solution import Service

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:
    from solution import GatewayTimeout


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.calls = 0
        self.fail = 0

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        if self.fail:
            self.fail -= 1
            raise GatewayTimeout()


def make(users=("alice",)):
    clock, gw = Clock(), Gateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw)
    tokens = []
    for u in users:
        assert svc.register(u, "password1")[0] == 201
        tokens.append(svc.login(u, "password1")[1]["token"])
    return (svc, clock, gw) + tuple(tokens)


def test_register_validation():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("ab", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("Abc", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("abc\n", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("a" * 33, "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("bob", "short")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("bob", "12345678")[0] == 201
    assert svc.register("bob", "12345678")[0] == 409


def test_token_expiry_and_logout():
    svc, clock, _, t = make()
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3599.9
    assert svc.export_documents(t)[0] == 200
    assert svc.logout(t2)[0] == 204
    assert svc.export_documents(t2)[0] == 401
    assert svc.logout(t2)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(t)[0] == 200
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3600
    assert svc.export_documents(t)[0] == 401


def test_document_validation():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    assert svc.create_document(t, "", "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 201, "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 200, "x" * 100000)[0] == 201
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400
    i = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.update_document(t, i, "", "")[0] == 400


def test_ids_not_reused():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    a = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(t, a)
    b = svc.create_document(t, "b", "")[1]["id"]
    assert a != b


def test_ownership():
    svc, _, _, ta, tb = make(("alice", "bob"))
    d = svc.create_document(ta, "secret", "x")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.get_document(tb, d) == (404, None)
    assert svc.update_document(tb, d, "t", "c")[0] == 404
    assert svc.delete_document(tb, d)[0] == 404
    assert svc.get_document(tb, "nope")[0] == 404
    assert svc.export_documents(tb)[1] == []
    assert svc.search_documents(tb, "secret")[1] == []
    assert svc.list_documents(tb)[1]["items"] == []
    assert svc.get_document(ta, d)[0] == 200


def test_pagination():
    svc, _, _, ta, tb = make(("alice", "bob"))
    ids = [svc.create_document(ta, "t%d" % i, "")[1]["id"] for i in range(5)]
    svc.create_document(tb, "other", "")
    got, cursor, first = [], None, None
    while True:
        s, page = svc.list_documents(ta, 2, cursor)
        assert s == 200
        first = first or page["next_cursor"]
        got += [d["id"] for d in page["items"]]
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break
    assert got == ids
    assert svc.list_documents(tb, 2, first)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 2, "bogus")[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 0)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 101)[0] == 400
    s, page = svc.list_documents(ta, 5)
    assert page["next_cursor"] is None and len(page["items"]) == 5


def test_search():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    svc.create_document(t, "Alpha", "zzz")
    svc.create_document(t, "beta", "an ALPHA inside")
    assert [d["title"] for d in svc.search_documents(t, "alpha")[1]] == ["Alpha", "beta"]
    assert svc.search_documents(t, "")[0] == 400


def test_deleted_never_returned():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    d = svc.create_document(t, "a", "needle")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(t, d)
    assert svc.search_documents(t, "needle")[1] == []
    assert svc.export_documents(t)[1] == []
    assert svc.list_documents(t)[1]["items"] == []
    assert svc.delete_document(t, d)[0] == 404


def test_payment_idempotency():
    svc, _, gw, ta, tb = make(("alice", "bob"))
    s, p = svc.pay(ta, 100, "k")
    assert s == 201
    s2, p2 = svc.pay(ta, 100, "k")
    assert s2 == 200 and p2["id"] == p["id"]
    assert svc.pay(ta, 200, "k")[0] == 409
    assert svc.pay(tb, 200, "k")[0] == 201
    assert len(gw.charges) == 2
    assert len(svc.list_payments(ta)[1]) == 1
    assert svc.pay(ta, 0, "z")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(ta, 1000001, "z")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(ta, 1.5, "z")[0] == 400


def test_payment_timeout_retry():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    gw.fail = 1
    assert svc.pay(t, 500, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.list_payments(t)[1] == []
    assert svc.pay(t, 600, "k")[0] == 409
    s, p = svc.pay(t, 500, "k")
    assert s in (200, 201)
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1
    assert svc.pay(t, 500, "k")[0] == 200
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1


def test_invalid_tokens():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    for f in (lambda t: svc.get_document(t, "x"), svc.export_documents,
              svc.list_payments, lambda t: svc.pay(t, 1, "k"),
              lambda t: svc.search_documents(t, "q"), svc.logout):
        assert f(None)[0] == 401
        assert f("bad")[0] == 401

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service
from gateway import GatewayTimeout

SETTINGS = settings(max_examples=40, deadline=None)

DOC_KEYS = {"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}
PAY_KEYS = {"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}
USER_CHARS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_"


def _timeout():
    try:
        return GatewayTimeout()
    except TypeError:
        return GatewayTimeout("timeout")


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    """Idempotent-by-reference fake. mode: None | 'before' | 'after'."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.calls = []
        self.mode = None

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.mode == "before":
            raise _timeout()
        if reference not in self.charges:
            self.charges[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "after":
            raise _timeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}


def make(ttl=3600, t=1000.0):
    clock = Clock(t)
    gw = Gateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw


def signup(svc, name, pw="password1"):
    out = svc.register(name, pw)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input={(name, pw)!r} output={out!r}"
    out = svc.login(name, pw)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input={(name, pw)!r} output={out!r}"
    return out[1]["token"]


def mk(svc, tok, title="t", content="c"):
    out = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input={(title, content)!r} output={out!r}"
    assert isinstance(out[1]["id"], str), f"output={out!r}"
    return out[1]["id"]


def traverse(svc, tok, page_size):
    pages = []
    cursor = None
    for _ in range(2000):
        out = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=page_size, cursor=cursor)
        assert out[0] == 200, f"input={(page_size, cursor)!r} output={out!r}"
        pages.append(out[1]["items"])
        cursor = out[1]["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            return pages
    pytest.fail(f"cursor chain did not terminate, page_size={page_size!r}")


def ids(docs):
    return [d["id"] for d in docs]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-14

def test_register_and_login_basic():
    """A registered user with correct credentials gets 200 and a token on login."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register("alice", "password1")
    assert out[0] == 201, f"output={out!r}"
    out = svc.login("alice", "password1")
    assert out[0] == 200 and isinstance(out[1]["token"], str), f"output={out!r}"


def test_login_wrong_password_or_unknown_user_is_401():
    """Login with a wrong password or an unknown user must return 401."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    for u, p in [("alice", "password2"), ("alice", ""), ("bob", "password1")]:
        out = svc.login(u, p)
        assert out[0] == 401, f"input={(u, p)!r} output={out!r}"


def test_duplicate_register_is_409_and_keeps_original_password():
    """Registering an existing username must return 409 and not change the credentials."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("alice", "password1")[0] == 201
    out = svc.register("alice", "otherpass9")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"output={out!r}"
    assert svc.login("alice", "password1")[0] == 200
    out = svc.login("alice", "otherpass9")
    assert out[0] == 401, f"output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name,expected", [
    ("abc", 201), ("a" * 32, 201), ("a_1", 201), ("___", 201),
    ("ab", 400), ("", 400), ("a" * 33, 400),
    ("Abc", 400), ("ab-c", 400), ("ab c", 400), ("ab.c", 400),
])
def test_username_boundaries(name, expected):
    """A username must be 3 to 32 characters from [a-z0-9_], otherwise 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert out[0] == expected, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pw,expected", [
    ("12345678", 201), ("1234567", 400), ("", 400), ("x" * 200, 201),
])
def test_password_boundaries(pw, expected):
    """A password must be at least 8 characters, otherwise 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register("alice", pw)
    assert out[0] == expected, f"input={pw!r} output={out!r}"


@SETTINGS
@given(st.text(alphabet=USER_CHARS, min_size=3, max_size=32),
       st.text(alphabet=st.characters(min_codepoint=32, max_codepoint=126), min_size=8, max_size=40))
def test_valid_credentials_register_and_login(name, pw):
    """Any valid username and password registers (201) and can log in (200)."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, pw)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input={(name, pw)!r} output={out!r}"
    out = svc.login(name, pw)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input={(name, pw)!r} output={out!r}"


@SETTINGS
@given(st.text(alphabet=USER_CHARS, min_size=2, max_size=30),
       st.sampled_from(list("ABZ-. @!/")),
       st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=100))
def test_username_with_illegal_char_is_400(base, bad, pos):
    """A username containing a character outside [a-z0-9_] must be rejected with 400."""
    p = pos % (len(base) + 1)
    name = base[:p] + bad + base[p:]
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


@SETTINGS
@given(st.text(alphabet=st.characters(min_codepoint=32, max_codepoint=126), max_size=7))
def test_short_password_is_400(pw):
    """A password shorter than 8 characters must be rejected with 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register("alice", pw)
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={pw!r} output={out!r}"


def test_each_login_returns_distinct_token():
    """Each login must return a new token."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    t1 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert t1 != t2, f"tokens={t1!r},{t2!r}"


def test_token_expiry_boundary():
    """A token is accepted while now < created + ttl and rejected from that instant."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=100, t=1000.0)
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    for t, exp in [(1000.0, 200), (1099.0, 200), (1099.999, 200), (1100.0, 401), (1100.5, 401), (5000.0, 401)]:
        clock.t = t
        out = svc.list_documents(tok)
        assert out[0] == exp, f"input=now {t!r} output={out!r}"


@SETTINGS
@given(st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=10000), st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=20000))
def test_token_expiry_property(ttl, offset):
    """A token is valid exactly when the elapsed time is strictly less than token_ttl."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=ttl, t=1000.0)
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    clock.t = 1000.0 + offset
    out = svc.export_documents(tok)
    exp = 200 if offset < ttl else 401
    assert out[0] == exp, f"input=ttl {ttl!r} offset {offset!r} output={out!r}"


def test_expiry_is_per_token_and_relogin_works():
    """Each token expires token_ttl seconds after its own creation, and a new login yields a valid token."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=100, t=1000.0)
    t1 = signup(svc, "alice")
    clock.t = 1050.0
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    clock.t = 1100.0
    assert svc.export_documents(t1)[0] == 401
    out = svc.export_documents(t2)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"output={out!r}"
    clock.t = 1150.0
    assert svc.export_documents(t2)[0] == 401
    t3 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert svc.export_documents(t3)[0] == 200


def all_calls(svc, tok, doc_id):
    return [
        ("create_document", lambda: svc.create_document(tok, "new", "body")),
        ("get_document", lambda: svc.get_document(tok, doc_id)),
        ("update_document", lambda: svc.update_document(tok, doc_id, "changed", "changed")),
        ("delete_document", lambda: svc.delete_document(tok, doc_id)),
        ("list_documents", lambda: svc.list_documents(tok)),
        ("search_documents", lambda: svc.search_documents(tok, "t")),
        ("export_documents", lambda: svc.export_documents(tok)),
        ("pay", lambda: svc.pay(tok, 100, "kx")),
        ("list_payments", lambda: svc.list_payments(tok)),
        ("logout", lambda: svc.logout(tok)),
    ]


def assert_untouched(svc, gw, doc_id):
    tok = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    out = svc.export_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 200 and len(out[1]) == 1, f"output={out!r}"
    d = out[1][0]
    assert d["id"] == doc_id and d["title"] == "t" and d["content"] == "c", f"output={out!r}"
    assert svc.list_payments(tok) == (200, []), f"output={svc.list_payments(tok)!r}"
    assert gw.charges == {}, f"charges={gw.charges!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [None, "", "no-such-token", 12345])
def test_unknown_or_missing_token_is_401_everywhere(bad):
    """Every token-taking method returns 401 for a missing or unknown token and has no effect."""
    svc, _, gw = make()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok)
    for name, call in all_calls(svc, bad, doc_id):
        out = call()
        assert out[0] == 401, f"input={name}({bad!r}) output={out!r}"
    assert_untouched(svc, gw, doc_id)


def test_expired_token_is_401_everywhere():
    """Every token-taking method returns 401 for an expired token and has no effect."""
    svc, clock, gw = make(ttl=100)
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok)
    clock.t += 100
    for name, call in all_calls(svc, tok, doc_id):
        out = call()
        assert out[0] == 401, f"input={name}(expired) output={out!r}"
    assert_untouched(svc, gw, doc_id)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-15

def test_logout_revokes_token_everywhere():
    """A revoked token is rejected by every method, and logout itself returns 204."""
    svc, _, gw = make()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok)
    out = svc.logout(tok)
    assert out[0] == 204, f"output={out!r}"
    for name, call in all_calls(svc, tok, doc_id):
        out = call()
        assert out[0] == 401, f"input={name}(revoked) output={out!r}"
    assert_untouched(svc, gw, doc_id)


def test_logout_keeps_other_tokens_of_same_user_valid():
    """Logging out one token must leave the user's other tokens valid."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    t1 = signup(svc, "alice")
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 204
    out = svc.list_documents(t2)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"output={out!r}"
    assert svc.list_documents(t1)[0] == 401


def test_logout_invalid_tokens_are_401():
    """Logout with a missing, unknown, already revoked or expired token must return 401."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=100)
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    assert svc.logout(None)[0] == 401
    assert svc.logout("bogus")[0] == 401
    assert svc.logout(tok)[0] == 204
    out = svc.logout(tok)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"output={out!r}"
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    clock.t += 100
    assert svc.logout(t2)[0] == 401


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-16

def test_create_and_get_document():
    """A created document is stored with the given data, its created_at is clock.now(), and it has the specified fields."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    clock.t = 1234.5
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok, "Hello", "World")
    out = svc.get_document(tok, doc_id)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"output={out!r}"
    d = out[1]
    assert set(d.keys()) == DOC_KEYS, f"output={out!r}"
    assert d["id"] == doc_id and d["title"] == "Hello" and d["content"] == "World", f"output={out!r}"
    assert d["created_at"] == 1234.5, f"output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("tlen,clen,expected", [
    (1, 0, 201), (200, 0, 201), (1, 100000, 201), (200, 100000, 201),
    (0, 5, 400), (201, 5, 400), (5, 100001, 400),
])
def test_create_document_length_boundaries(tlen, clen, expected):
    """Title must be 1 to 200 characters and content at most 100,000, otherwise 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    out = svc.create_document(tok, "t" * tlen, "c" * clen)
    assert out[0] == expected, f"input=title {tlen!r} content {clen!r} output={out[0]!r}"
    if expected == 400:
        assert svc.export_documents(tok) == (200, []), "invalid document must not be stored"


@SETTINGS
@given(st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=200))
def test_valid_title_lengths_accepted(n):
    """Every title length from 1 to 200 is accepted with 201."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    out = svc.create_document(tok, "x" * n, "c")
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input=title length {n!r} output={out!r}"


@SETTINGS
@given(st.integers(min_value=201, max_value=400))
def test_overlong_titles_rejected(n):
    """Every title longer than 200 characters is rejected with 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    out = svc.create_document(tok, "x" * n, "c")
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input=title length {n!r} output={out!r}"


def test_ids_unique_and_never_reused_after_delete():
    """Document ids are unique for the lifetime of the service and never reused after deletion."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    a = signup(svc, "alice")
    b = signup(svc, "bob")
    seen = []
    for i in range(6):
        seen.append(mk(svc, a, f"a{i}"))
        seen.append(mk(svc, b, f"b{i}"))
        if i % 2 == 0:
            assert svc.delete_document(a, seen[-2])[0] == 204
    for _ in range(3):
        seen.append(mk(svc, a, "again"))
    assert len(set(seen)) == len(seen), f"ids={seen!r}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-17 / REQ-18

def test_other_user_gets_404_for_foreign_and_missing_documents():
    """A request by B on a document of A returns 404, like for a nonexistent document, and leaks nothing."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    a = signup(svc, "alice")
    b = signup(svc, "bobby")
    doc_id = mk(svc, a, "SECRET-TITLE", "SECRET-CONTENT")
    missing = svc.get_document(b, "does-not-exist")
    assert missing[0] == 404, f"output={missing!r}"
    for name, out in [
        ("get", svc.get_document(b, doc_id)),
        ("update", svc.update_document(b, doc_id, "x", "y")),
        ("delete", svc.delete_document(b, doc_id)),
    ]:
        assert out[0] == 404, f"input={name} output={out!r}"
        assert "SECRET" not in repr(out[1]), f"input={name} output={out!r}"
    d = svc.get_document(a, doc_id)
    assert d[0] == 200 and d[1]["title"] == "SECRET-TITLE" and d[1]["content"] == "SECRET-CONTENT", f"output={d!r}"


def test_other_user_collections_never_contain_foreign_documents():
    """List, search and export by B never contain documents owned by A."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    a = signup(svc, "alice")
    b = signup(svc, "bobby")
    for i in range(3):
        mk(svc, a, f"secret{i}", "secret content")
    mk(svc, b, "mine", "plain")
    lst = svc.list_documents(b)
    srch = svc.search_documents(b, "secret")
    exp = svc.export_documents(b)
    assert lst[0] == 200 and [d["title"] for d in lst[1]["items"]] == ["mine"], f"output={lst!r}"
    assert srch == (200, []), f"output={srch!r}"

            continue

    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # make the exception importable the same way for the service
    _m = types.ModuleType("gateway")

    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

    _m.GatewayTimeout = GatewayTimeout
    sys.modules["gateway"] = _m

from solution import Service  # noqa: E402


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = []
        self.timeouts = 0
        self.after = False

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.timeouts > 0:
            self.timeouts -= 1
            if self.after:
                self.charged.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charged.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        return {"ok": True}


def mk(ttl=3600):
    clock = Clock()
    gw = Gateway()
    return Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl), clock, gw


def user(svc, name="alice", pw="password1"):

USER = st.sampled_from(["alice", "bobby"])
TITLE = st.text(alphabet="abAB1 ", min_size=1, max_size=10)
CONTENT = st.text(alphabet="abAB1 ", max_size=20)


class DocMachine(RuleBasedStateMachine):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.svc, self.clock, self.gw = make()
        self.tokens = {u: signup(self.svc, u) for u in ("alice", "bobby")}
        self.model = {"alice": [], "bobby": []}
        self.all_ids = set()
        self.deleted = []

    @rule(user=USER, title=TITLE, content=CONTENT, dt=st.integers(0, 3))
    def create(self, user, title, content, dt):
        self.clock.advance(dt)
        out = self.svc.create_document(self.tokens[user], title, content)
        assert out[0] == 201, f"input={(user, title, content)!r} output={out!r}"
        did = out[1]["id"]
        assert isinstance(did, str) and did not in self.all_ids, f"input={(user, title, content)!r} output={out!r}"
        self.all_ids.add(did)
        self.model[user].append({"id": did, "title": title, "content": content, "created_at": self.clock.now()})

    @rule(user=USER, idx=st.integers(0, 30))
    def delete(self, user, idx):
        docs = self.model[user]
        if not docs:
            return
        d = docs.pop(idx % len(docs))
        out = self.svc.delete_document(self.tokens[user], d["id"])
        assert out[0] == 204, f"input={(user, d['id'])!r} output={out!r}"
        self.deleted.append((user, d["id"]))

    @rule(user=USER, idx=st.integers(0, 30), title=TITLE, content=CONTENT)
    def update(self, user, idx, title, content):
        docs = self.model[user]
        if not docs:
            return
        d = docs[idx % len(docs)]
        out = self.svc.update_document(self.tokens[user], d["id"], title, content)
        assert out[0] == 200, f"input={(user, d['id'], title, content)!r} output={out!r}"
        d["title"], d["content"] = title, content
        assert proj(out[1]) == d, f"input={(user, d['id'], title, content)!r} output={out!r}"

        if self.mode == "after":

        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}

"""
Guarantees imposed by the specification:

- Every Service method returns (status, body), where body is a dict, list, or None.
- Usernames are valid iff they are 3 to 32 chars from [a-z0-9_]; passwords are valid iff length >= 8.
- Register creates users, rejects invalid inputs with 400, and rejects duplicate usernames with 409.
- Login succeeds only with correct credentials and returns a fresh token; bad credentials return 401.
- Tokens are accepted exactly while clock.now() < created + token_ttl; missing, unknown, expired, or revoked tokens get 401.
- Logout revokes only the supplied token; other tokens for the same user remain valid.
- Document creation validates title length 1..200 and content length <= 100000, stores owner/title/content/created_at, and returns a unique never-reused id.
- Users can only observe their own documents through get/list/search/export/update/delete; foreign docs behave like nonexistent docs with 404.
- Updating validates like creation, changes only owner-visible docs, and preserves ownership.
- Deletion is owner-only; deleted docs are never returned again and further get/update/delete return 404.
- Listing returns caller-owned non-deleted docs in creation order, page_size must be 1..100, next_cursor is None on last page, and issued cursors must be caller-scoped.
- Search rejects an empty query with 400 and otherwise returns caller-owned matching documents in case-insensitive creation order.
- Export returns all caller-owned non-deleted documents in creation order.
- Payments validate amount as integer 1..1000000, charge through the gateway, record created_at from the clock, and list per-caller payments in creation order.
- GatewayTimeout from the gateway makes pay return 504 and record no payment.
- Idempotency keys are scoped to caller: same key+amount returns the original payment with 200 and no new payment; same key+different amount returns 409.
- After a timeout, retrying the same caller/key/amount must eventually create at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.

OPEN QUESTIONS:
- Error response bodies are unspecified.
- Token, document id, payment id, cursor, and gateway reference formats are unspecified.
- Behavior for non-string username/password/title/content/query inputs is unspecified.
- The gateway charge return value is unspecified.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, strategies as st

from gateway import GatewayTimeout
from solution import Service


VALID_USERNAME_CHARS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_"


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=0.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def set(self, t):
        self.t = float(t)

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += float(dt)


class RecordingGateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.charged_references = set()

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        self.charged_references.add(reference)
        return None


class AlwaysTimeoutGateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        raise GatewayTimeout()


class TimeoutAfterChargingOnceGateway:
    """First call has unknown outcome after charging; later same reference is idempotent."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.charged_references = set()
        self._first = True

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self._first:
            self._first = False
            self.charged_references.add(reference)
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charged_references.add(reference)
        return None
